gloss: to be convinced; to be satisfied; to make sense

definitions.gloss: to be convinced; to be satisfied with an explanation; to make sense
definitions.explanation: To reach a state of understanding and acceptance about something. Often used when an explanation finally makes sense or when one is satisfied with the reasoning behind something.

examples.japanese: ⟦それ→それ：00994_sore⟧なら{納得|なっとく}がいく。
⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧いった。
examples.english: After hearing the explanation, I was finally convinced.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧{納得|なっとく}がいかない⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦もう{一度|いちど}→もう一度：02976_mouichido⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}いたい→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: I'm just not satisfied with it, so I'd like to discuss it one more time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いく⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{続|つづ}ける→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: I'll keep going until I get a result I'm satisfied with.

notes:
A common expression combining ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧ (acceptance, understanding) with the verb いく (to go). The negative form {納得|なっとく}がいかない (to not be satisfied, to not be able to accept) is used at least as frequently as the positive form. Can also appear as ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いく as a modifier before nouns.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {納得|なっとく}がいく: to be convinced / it makes sense
- {納得|なっとく}がいかない: to not be satisfied / it doesn't make sense
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いく + noun: a satisfactory ~
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}→納得：03507_nattoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧いく⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧: until one is satisfied

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{納得|なっとく}する→納得する：26805_nattokusuru⟧: to be convinced — simpler construction with the same core meaning; {納得|なっとく}がいく emphasizes reaching the state of acceptance
- {合点|がてん}がいく: to understand, to be convinced — older/literary expression with a similar structure
- ⟦{腑|ふ}に{落|お}ちる→腑に落ちる：09908_funiochiru⟧: to make sense, to be persuaded — emphasizes the moment something clicks intuitively
